# CLDR keyboard files (release-49)

Unmodified copies of files from https://github.com/unicode-org/cldr/tree/release-49/keyboards
(fetched 2026-11-22), kept as test fixtures and as the source of `examples/cldr-pt-abnt2.kbl.json`.
They are under the Unicode License v3 (`LICENSE` in this folder), not under the repository's MIT-0.

| file | use |
|---|---|
| `keyboards/3.0/pt-t-k0-abnt2.xml` | source of example (c) |
| `keyboards/test/pt-t-k0-abnt2-test.xml` | its CLDR test file, converted into the example's `tests` |
| `keyboards/import/keys-Zyyy-punctuation.xml`, `keys-Zyyy-currency.xml` | imported by it; inlined in the example |
| `keyboards/import/keys-Latn-implied.xml`, `scanCodes-implied.xml` | CLDR's implied keys and hardware forms |
| `keyboards/3.0/fr-t-k0-test.xml`, `keyboards/test/fr-t-k0-test-test.xml` | touch layers, flicks, long-press, multi-tap, displays |
| `keyboards/3.0/ja-Hira-t-k0-flicks.xml` | a flick-based touch keyboard |
